# Phases 2-4 Implementation Plan
**Date**: 2025-11-14  
**Status**: Ready for Implementation  
**Backend Status**: ✅ Complete (all endpoints exist)  
**Frontend Status**: 🔄 Ready to build 6 pages

## Backend API Inventory (Already Implemented)

### License Endpoints
```
POST   /admin/licenses           → Create license (admin only)
GET    /user/licenses            → Get user's licenses (authenticated)
GET    /licenses/active          → Get active licenses (query handler)
GET    /licenses/expiring        → Get expiring licenses (query handler)
GET    /licenses/org             → Get org licenses (query handler)
GET    /licenses/summary         → Get license summary (query handler)
```

### Approval Endpoints
```
GET    /admin/approvals          → List pending approvals
GET    /admin/approvals/:id      → Get approval details
POST   /admin/approvals/:id/approve → Approve request
POST   /admin/approvals/:id/reject  → Reject request
```

### Product Endpoints
```
POST   /admin/products           → Create product (admin only)
GET    /user/licenses            → Lists available products implicitly
```

### Team Endpoints
```
POST   /team/create              → Create team
GET    /team/list                → List teams
GET    /team/:id                 → Get team details
POST   /team/:id/members         → Add member
GET    /team/:id/members         → List members
PUT    /team/:id/members/:uid    → Update member role
DELETE /team/:id/members/:uid    → Remove member
```

## Phase 2: License Management (Admin & User Views)

### Scope
- Admin license CRUD interface
- User license viewing
- License status display (active, pending, expiring)
- Approval workflow UI

### Files to Create

#### 1. `client/app/admin/licenses/page.tsx`
**Purpose**: Admin dashboard for license management
**Features**:
- List all licenses with pagination
- Filter by: status (active/pending/expired), user, product, date range
- Create license modal:
  - User selection (dropdown with search)
  - Product selection (from UPID list)
  - Days valid input
  - Daily/monthly limits
  - Submit with Nonce validation
- Edit license modal:
  - Update limits
  - Extend expiration
  - Mark as revoked
- Bulk actions (revoke multiple)
- Export to CSV

**API Calls**:
```typescript
GET    /admin/licenses?skip=0&take=20&status=active
POST   /admin/licenses { user_id, product_upid, days_valid, daily_limit?, monthly_limit? }
PUT    /admin/licenses/:id { daily_limit?, monthly_limit?, expires_at? }
POST   /admin/licenses/:id/revoke
```

**Component Structure**:
```
<AdminLicensesPage>
  ├─ <LicenseTable /> - Read-only table with actions
  ├─ <CreateLicenseModal /> - Form to create
  ├─ <EditLicenseModal /> - Form to edit
  ├─ <FilterBar /> - Status/user/product filters
  └─ <PaginationNav /> - Pagination controls
```

#### 2. `client/app/dashboard/licenses/mine/page.tsx`
**Purpose**: User's personal license view
**Features**:
- Display user's assigned licenses
- Show status: active/pending/expiring/revoked
- License details:
  - Product name
  - Expiration date
  - Daily/monthly usage
  - Current usage (if tracking enabled)
  - UPID for offline verification
- Download license certificate
- Copy to clipboard
- Request extension (form)

**API Calls**:
```typescript
GET    /user/licenses
GET    /licenses/summary
GET    /licenses/active?user_id=xxx
```

**Component Structure**:
```
<MyLicensesPage>
  ├─ <LicenseCard /> × N - Individual license display
  ├─ <UsageMetrics /> - Daily/monthly usage
  ├─ <RequestExtensionModal /> - Form to request
  └─ <ExportLicenseButton /> - Download certificate
```

#### 3. Update `client/app/admin/approvals/page.tsx`
**Purpose**: Approval workflow for license requests
**Features** (Update existing):
- Mark license approval requests separately from other approvals
- Add approval action panel:
  - View request details
  - Preview license parameters
  - Approve button → creates license
  - Reject button → sends notification
  - Comments section
- Show approval status timeline
- Bulk approve/reject

**Component Changes**:
```
<AdminApprovalsPage>
  ├─ <ApprovalTypeFilter /> - Filter by type (license, upgrade, other)
  ├─ <ApprovalList />
  │  └─ <ApprovalCard />
  │     ├─ <RequestDetails />
  │     ├─ <ApprovalActions /> ← NEW: approve/reject buttons
  │     └─ <StatusTimeline /> ← NEW: approval history
  └─ <BulkActions /> ← NEW: bulk approve/reject
```

## Phase 3: License Request & Assignment (Employee & Manager Views)

### Scope
- Employee license request submission
- Manager license assignment workflow
- Product browsing
- Request status tracking

### Files to Create

#### 4. `client/app/dashboard/licenses/request/page.tsx`
**Purpose**: Employee form to request licenses
**Features**:
- Request form:
  - Product selection (dropdown with descriptions)
  - Justification text area
  - Required by date picker
  - Team selection (if applicable)
  - Submit button
- Recent requests list:
  - Status badges (pending/approved/rejected)
  - Dates
  - View details
- Request history with filtering

**API Calls**:
```typescript
POST   /license-requests { product_upid, justification, required_by, team_id? }
GET    /license-requests/mine?status=all|pending|approved|rejected
GET    /license-requests/:id
DELETE /license-requests/:id (cancel if pending)
```

**Component Structure**:
```
<RequestLicensePage>
  ├─ <LicenseRequestForm /> - Request creation
  │  ├─ ProductSelect
  │  ├─ DatePicker
  │  ├─ TextArea (justification)
  │  └─ SubmitButton (with Nonce)
  ├─ <RequestStatusBadge /> - Color-coded status
  └─ <PreviousRequests /> - List with filtering
```

#### 5. `client/app/dashboard/licenses/assign/page.tsx`
**Purpose**: Manager/Team Lead license assignment interface
**Features**:
- Pending approvals list:
  - Employee name
  - Product requested
  - Justification
  - Request date
- Assignment form:
  - Auto-select approved request
  - Product confirmation (read-only)
  - Days valid input (dropdown: 30/60/90/365 days)
  - Limits input (daily/monthly)
  - Notes/conditions textarea
  - Assign button
- Bulk assignment:
  - Multi-select requests
  - Apply same days/limits to all
  - Assign batch

**API Calls**:
```typescript
GET    /license-requests?status=approved&assigned_by_me=true
POST   /admin/licenses { user_id, product_upid, days_valid, daily_limit?, monthly_limit? }
PUT    /license-requests/:id/assign { license_id, assigned_by_id }
```

**Component Structure**:
```
<AssignLicensesPage>
  ├─ <ApprovedRequestsList /> - Requests ready to assign
  ├─ <LicenseAssignmentForm /> - Create & assign license
  │  ├─ ProductDisplay (read-only)
  │  ├─ DaysValidSelect
  │  ├─ LimitsInput
  │  └─ SubmitButton (with Nonce)
  └─ <BulkAssignmentModal /> - Multi-assign
```

#### 6. `client/app/dashboard/products/available/page.tsx`
**Purpose**: Product catalog for license browsing
**Features**:
- Product grid/list:
  - Product name
  - UPID
  - Description
  - Tier requirement (free/standard/premium)
  - Usage limits (daily/monthly)
  - Request button
- Filters:
  - By tier required
  - By category (if added to DB)
  - By usage limits
- Product details modal:
  - Full description
  - Pricing tier
  - Limits
  - Requirements
  - Request form inline

**API Calls**:
```typescript
GET    /products?skip=0&take=20&category=all
GET    /products/:id
POST   /license-requests { product_upid, justification, required_by }
```

**Component Structure**:
```
<AvailableProductsPage>
  ├─ <FilterBar />
  ├─ <ProductGrid /> or <ProductTable />
  │  └─ <ProductCard />
  │     ├─ ProductInfo
  │     ├─ LimitsDisplay
  │     ├─ TierBadge
  │     └─ RequestButton
  └─ <ProductDetailsModal /> - Deep view + request form
```

## Phase 4: Testing & Optimization

### Testing Checklist
1. **License Creation Flow**
   - [ ] Admin creates license successfully
   - [ ] License appears in user's `/user/licenses`
   - [ ] UPID included in license data

2. **Approval Workflow**
   - [ ] Requests appear in approvals list
   - [ ] Approve action creates license
   - [ ] Reject sends notification
   - [ ] Status updates in real-time

3. **User License View**
   - [ ] User sees all assigned licenses
   - [ ] Status badges display correctly
   - [ ] Expiration dates calculate properly
   - [ ] Export/copy functions work

4. **Manager Assignment**
   - [ ] Manager sees pending approvals
   - [ ] Can create and assign licenses
   - [ ] Bulk assignment works
   - [ ] Notifications sent

5. **Request Workflow**
   - [ ] Employee submits request
   - [ ] Appears in manager's queue
   - [ ] Manager can approve/reject
   - [ ] Status updates in employee's view

6. **Product Browsing**
   - [ ] Products display with all info
   - [ ] Filters work correctly
   - [ ] Can request from product page
   - [ ] Tier restrictions enforced

### Performance Optimization
- [ ] Pagination on all list views (20 items default)
- [ ] Lazy load product descriptions
- [ ] Cache product list for 5 minutes
- [ ] Debounce search inputs
- [ ] Use React.memo for static components

### Documentation Updates
- [ ] Update main README with Phase 2-4 completion
- [ ] Add user guide for request workflow
- [ ] Add admin guide for license management
- [ ] Document all new frontend routes

## Implementation Strategy

### Code Organization (Consistent with Phase 1)

**API Client Methods** (`lib/api-client.ts`):
```typescript
// License Management
async getAdminLicenses(skip?: number, take?: number)
async createLicense(data: CreateLicenseRequest)
async updateLicense(id: number, data: UpdateLicenseRequest)
async revokeLicense(id: number)

// User Licenses
async getUserLicenses()
async getLicensesSummary()

// Requests
async submitLicenseRequest(data: LicenseRequestData)
async getUserRequests()
async getApprovedRequests()
async assignLicense(requestId: number, licenseId: number)

// Products
async getAvailableProducts(filters?: ProductFilters)
async getProductDetails(id: number)
```

**Type Definitions** (`lib/types.ts`):
```typescript
interface License {
  id: number;
  user_id: number;
  product_upid: string;
  status: 'active' | 'pending' | 'expired' | 'revoked';
  created_at: string;
  expires_at: string;
  daily_limit?: number;
  monthly_limit?: number;
  current_usage?: number;
}

interface LicenseRequest {
  id: number;
  user_id: number;
  product_upid: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'approved' | 'rejected' | 'assigned';
  justification: string;
  required_by: string;
  created_at: string;
}
```

### Modular Components (For Independent Developer)
- Each page component ≤ 300 lines
- Extract business logic to custom hooks
- Separate presentational from container components
- Clear prop interfaces with JSDoc comments
- Reusable modal/form components

### Error Handling
- User-friendly error messages
- Retry logic for failed requests
- Loading states on all async operations
- Validation feedback before submission

### Git Strategy
- Phase 2: Single commit "feat: implement license management (pages 1-3)"
- Phase 3: Single commit "feat: implement license requests (pages 4-6)"
- Phase 4: Single commit "test: integrate and optimize Phases 2-4"

---

## Success Criteria

✅ **Phase 2 Complete When**:
- Admin can create/edit/revoke licenses
- Users can view assigned licenses
- Approval workflow fully integrated
- All 3 pages display without errors

✅ **Phase 3 Complete When**:
- Employees can submit license requests
- Managers can view and assign licenses
- Products can be browsed with filters
- All 3 pages functional and linked

✅ **Phase 4 Complete When**:
- All 6 pages tested end-to-end
- Performance metrics acceptable
- Documentation updated
- Ready for production deployment
